evidence_label: compiler-level synthetic-topology robustness; not physical hardware execution or timing evidence
interpretation: The locked line-topology baseline is exactly reproduced before alternate-topology evidence is accepted.
Concrete routed depth and CX counts are topology-sensitive.

The alternate synthetic connectivity maps do not reveal a line-specific inflation pattern that reverses the compiler-level interpretation; ladder routing is generally cheaper and ring routing is typically similar to or cheaper than line for QAOA, while sparse-oracle ring routing is essentially unchanged.
No backend calibration, duration, fidelity, queue-time, energy, or hardware-speedup claim is made.
